official_definition: Genesis (When Attacks) You can reveal cards from your decktop until you reveal a "Creation" family card (You can repeat this up to three times). Put one core from your Field/Red Grandwalker Nexuses to each of those cards to summon them. Remaining cards are discarded.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Genesis] or [Genesis: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Genesis]", "give [Genesis]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
